Chapter 597: Chapter 29: Twilight of the Gods (Subscribe Please)_2

“`

Many demigod old monsters were communicating rapidly.

“As many as twenty-four upper-rank gods, actually entering the arena to slaughter ordinary True Gods…” a relatively younger demigod said indignantly, wanting to condemn the twenty-four prime gods.

Just at this moment.

In the higher sky, situated above all the stars, hung twenty-four colossal stars, which belonged to the divine kingdoms of the prime gods.

And now, following the fall of star after star to the mortal realm, these twenty-four colossal stars also began to fall one by one.

...

One.

Two.

Five.

Ten.

…

In just a few breaths, more than ten prime gods’ divine kingdoms had plummeted to the mortal world.

This silenced the demigods of the mortal realm who were condemning and criticizing the twenty-four prime gods, and immediately after, they plunged into confusion.

It turned out that it was not only the True Gods that were perishing.

Were the prime gods also perishing?

This scene filled all the demigods with an unprecedented terror.

The prime gods were falling.

And it was a mass downfall at that.

Then who exactly was the one carrying out the slaughter?

If the twenty-four prime gods were joining forces to slaughter the True Gods, how could the prime gods possibly be falling as well?

It is known… the battles between prime gods are long, and even for the strongest Light Prime God and the Dark God, killing the weakest prime god is almost impossible.

Not to mention a crushing defeat like this?

“What on earth happened in the Ocean of Light and the Dark Abyss…” murmured an elderly demigod whose lifespan was coming to an end and whose divine fire was about to go out.

Even the prime gods were perishing, something that not even a ‘Divine War’ had ever seen.

“It’s the twilight of the gods, this is the twilight of the gods…” another demigod thought silently to himself.

The gods here refer to both True Gods and prime gods.

…

“Not good, the divine kingdoms falling into the mortal realm will have an immeasurable impact on the mortal world,” speculated one demigod, seemingly recalling something.

Even the mighty demigods were shocked by the sight of the stars falling from the sky, but very few of them considered what consequences these stars falling into the mortal realm might lead to?

Years ago, the divine wars of the gods caused several stars to fall into the mortal realm, leading to irreversible destructive effects on the mortal world.

Tens of thousands of years have not recovered, and those forbidden and desolate places in the mortal realm are exactly where the divine kingdoms ultimately fell.

After all… what fell were not mere stars, but divine kingdoms, containing vast amounts of energy.

The fallout from just a few stars was severe enough; now with the stars cascading, and among them, even more vast divine kingdoms of the prime gods…

If these divine kingdoms really hit the ground, perhaps the mortal realm might still exist, but nine out of ten of all living beings dwelling there would surely perish.

These demigod old monsters wouldn’t be likely to survive much longer either.

“This is not the twilight of the gods; this is the apocalypse of all beings…” proclaimed a demigod who showed himself, not caring to hide any longer, for in any case, all would die.

As for running? With the speed at which the stars fell to the mortal world, where could the demigods possibly flee? And with so many stars falling together, no matter how far they ran, they would still be within the range of the divine kingdoms.

Hum!!!

Just as many demigods turned pale, realizing they were about to face death.

A black and white yin-yang barrier, slicing across the vast mortal realm in the form of a ‘giant net,’ caught all the stars falling into the mortal world within its grasp.

At the ends of the mortal realm.

Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit and the Taiyang Divine Spirit, stood aloft in the sky.

The ‘giant net’ of Yin-Yang Taiji that ‘sliced’ through the entire mortal realm was precisely Lin Yuan’s doing.

Long ago, Lin Yuan had his sights set on the divine kingdoms of the gods, which had existed for tens of thousands of years, absorbing countless faith and containing massive amounts of pure energy.

Now that Lin Yuan’s true body had gone to negotiate in the Ocean of Light with the gods, should the negotiations fail and fighting begin, Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t waste the falling stars.

Even if he had no use for them himself, he could use the “Primal Force” to revert all divine kingdoms back to their original source, turning them into the purest energy, for the Origin Fine Gold to absorb.

“`

With “indirect” means, they were brought back to the Main World.

Whoosh.

Along with the unfurling of the immense Yin-Yang Taiji net of black and white, countless Divine Kingdoms of the gods appeared within Lin Yuan’s Inner World.

To accommodate so many Divine Kingdoms at once, even including those of Prime Gods, would certainly cause the Inner World of any other Ninth Rank powerhouse to burst.

Yet, the apparent size of Lin Yuan’s Inner World was close to two hundred million miles in diameter, and it even established one hundred twenty million Spatial Layers.

Most importantly, Lin Yuan had three such Inner Worlds.

One for his true self, one for the Taiyang Divine Spirit, and one for the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

For three hundred years, Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits had already used the “Illusory Reality” Secret Technique to turn into flesh and blood, and then, with the aid of the Mysterious Gourd, they amplified their physical bodies and Inner Worlds to the current limit.

“Too many, too many.”

Lin Yuan’s mind was filled with pleasure; as each Divine Kingdom entered his Inner World, it was quickly ‘dissolved,’ ‘segregated,’ and then integrated into the ‘bell-shaped’ Origin Fine Gold.

…

The vast mortal realm.

The numerous demigods, who were just preparing to close their eyes and await death, suddenly discovered an extra layer of black and white Yin-Yang Taiji ‘giant net’ under the vault of heaven.

All stars falling into the mortal realm disappeared the moment they touched the ‘giant net,’ as if they had never existed.

“What is this? It actually stopped the Divine Kingdoms from falling down?”

The many ancient demigods couldn’t believe it. Divine Kingdoms falling from atop the sky carried terrifying energy and impact, definitely far surpassing a single strike from a True God burning their Divine Body and divine powers.

Countless stars falling were akin to the gods igniting everything in a final blaze of glory; even the Prime Gods dared not withstand it directly.

But now, under that black and white ‘giant net,’ all falling stars were easily nullified, including the vast Divine Kingdoms of Prime Gods.

“The owner of this ‘giant net’…”

Some ancient demigods trembled inwardly, faintly guessing that the owner of the ‘giant net’ might be the source behind the fall of the gods and the Prime Gods.

Otherwise, how could things be so coincidental?

The stars suspended in the heavens had just started to fall, and they were immediately caught by the ‘giant net’?

And the strength to effortlessly bear the impact of so many stars falling, couldn’t the slaughter of gods and Prime Gods also be within the realm of possibility?

…

Ocean of Light.

Under the strike driven by Lin Yuan’s Inner World, a terrifying force crushed everything it touched through layer upon layer of space.

In just an instant, over eighty percent of True Gods had perished, and the remaining twenty percent were Upper-Rank Gods at their Peak; even if reduced to dust, they could reconvene.

The divine beings of this part of the world had undergone a transformation, forgoing their original flesh and blood bodies; their Divine Bodies were composed of the purest faith.

There were no weaknesses.

However, it’s unfortunate that under the strike that vibrated through multiple Spatial Layers time and again, no matter how many times these Upper-Rank Gods reconvened, they would turn to dust once more.

Even the lofty Prime Gods, caught off guard, saw their Divine Bodies shatter numerous times. Lin Yuan’s strike primarily targeted the Prime Gods; as for the True Gods, they mostly only endured the aftershocks.

Thus, before a small number of True Gods had entirely perished, some Prime Gods had begun to fall.

“What exactly is this, what level of power is this?”

“Goddess of the Magic Web, didn’t you say that the Longshan Patriarch didn’t surpass the ninth level?”

“This is a Supreme God, this is the power at the level of a Supreme God.”

One by one, the Prime Gods roared, using every method to resist the strike that pierced through countless Spatial Layers, but to no avail; their Divine Bodies shattered over and over again.

Even with the profound depths of the Prime Gods, they couldn’t endure such repeated destruction.

“Go.”

The Dark God from the dark abyss didn’t hesitate to try and flee, but quickly encountered the barrier of Spatial Layers sealed by the Light God.

“Light God, you deserve to die.”

The Prime Gods of the dark abyss cursed the Light God in their hearts. The barrier sealing the Ocean of Light’s Spatial Layers, to beings like these Prime Gods, posed difficulty to break, but it was just difficulty.

It would simply take some time.

But now, where was there any time?

Boom, boom, boom.

Prime God after Prime God from the dark abyss tried to escape, but failed to do so.
